question:
The perimeter of the polygon shown is

[Figure 1](figures/1986_AMC_8_Q13_question_fig1.svg)
solution:
We do not need the length of each individual step. The marked right angles make the sides alternate between horizontal and vertical directions.

The bottom horizontal side and the horizontal side at the step together span the full width of the polygon. Their combined length is therefore the top length, \(8\). Similarly, the outer right vertical side and the vertical side at the step together span the full height. Their combined length equals the left side, \(6\).

The perimeter is the sum of all boundary lengths. Including the top and left sides gives
\[
P=8+8+6+6=\boxed{28}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\text{C}\).
